hero.title: Buy straight from the herder. Spend a day living like one.
hero.subtitle: No middlemen. Order dairy made by the very family that herds the livestock, milks the mares and dries the aaruul — then visit them and live the nomadic life together.
hero.searchPlaceholder: Try airag, aaruul, a soum or a herder's name...

benefits.title: No middlemen
items: The herder themselves, not a reseller
Pick up along your travel route

steps.title: Choose
steps.text: Pick your dairy from a herder's corral, or the family you'd like to stay with.

steps.title: Arrange directly with the herder
steps.text: Your order goes straight to the herder. They set their own prices.

steps.title: Collect along the way
steps.text: Stop by on your journey to pick up your dairy, stay the night and lend a hand.
